title: aquilegia formosa var. flavescens
intro: Aquilegia formosa var. flavescens, commonly known as golden columbine, is a perennial flowering plant species in the Ranunculaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and reduce fever. The therapeutic actions of Aquilegia formosa var. flavescens include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial agent, as well as its potential to help with menstrual cramps and other gynecological issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
